title: The morning paper and the news
situation: You are {{Kara}}. Before you leave your shelter there is a magazine within reach, and if you have the motel room, the television is on.

media.title: {{Detroit}} Today: Cyber-Wildlife
facts: {{CyberLife}} is opening android zoos full of recreated extinct animals; it says they will be more real than the real thing.

media.title: Travel advertisement: {{Canada}} Still Android-Free
facts: Across the river, the neighbouring country has never legalized androids; none are sold there and they have no legal status, and it advertises itself as a place with clean air and a warm welcome.

media.title: the morning news report about you
facts: A reporter is covering {{Todd}}'s death: an unemployed man shot by his own household android, with a police search now under way for the android and a child.

media.title: the morning news report about you
facts: {{Todd}} is on television telling a reporter his android attacked him without provocation while he was having dinner; the reporter calls it disturbing news for every android owner.

adaptationNote: Optional reading or viewing. Contents are summarized from the in-game magazine articles and broadcasts. Watching certain news reports about android incidents lowers public opinion, as in the game.

title: Getting past the police
situation: You are {{Kara}}. In the morning the street outside is full of police and a drone; {{Todd}} has reported you and the news is calling you a kidnapper. You and {{Alice}} need to reach the train station a few blocks away. You can move carefully from cover to cover, waiting for patrols to pass, or just walk and run for it if anyone notices.

options.text: Move carefully and hide from every patrol until you reach the station.
Make no attempt to hide; if you are spotted, run.

adaptationNote: The game uses stealth inputs rather than an explicit detection menu. Deliberate non-evasion triggers the chase.

title: The squat
situation: You are {{Connor}}. You and {{Hank}} are investigating the runaway domestic android and the child she took, and your analysis has led to an abandoned house. A scarred, agitated android named {{Ralph}} meets you at the door, swears nobody else is here, and plants himself at the foot of the stairs. {{Hank}} says you are wasting your time. You can hear something upstairs.

options.text: Push past him and search upstairs.
Take {{Hank}}'s word for it and leave.

title: The highway
situation: You are {{Connor}}. The android and the girl have bolted across six lanes of freeway traffic at full speed, dodging cars. You could still catch them if you go now. {{Hank}} grabs your arm and yells at you not to, saying you will get yourself killed and that they will get them another day.

options.text: Do as {{Hank}} says and let them go.
Go after them across the traffic.
